meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: 做网页与界面工作时,会先按规则加载设计、性能、配色等资料库,强制先建立 DESIGN.md 再写组件,用真实浏览器跑 Lighthouse 审计,要求每项满分,并产出有参考依据、可复用的设计系统。
howto.when: 当用户提到 UI、UX、设计等词,要求搭建或改版页面或组件、处理 React、做性能或无障碍审计,或说“make it pretty”“像某品牌”等时触发。

say.text: 把落地页按 Linear 的风格重新设计,先建 DESIGN.md 再改。
say.note: 会先抓取参考网站真实样式写入 DESIGN.md,再动手。

say.text: 给这个 React 应用做性能审计,把 Lighthouse 各项修到满分。
say.note: 会构建生产版本,用真实浏览器多次测量取中位数。

say.text: 帮我做一套按钮、表单等基础组件,带悬停和点击动效。
say.note: 动效会参照 beui.dev 的交互目录来做。

howto.what_en: Routes frontend/UI/UX work through design, performance and UI/UX rulesets; mandates a DESIGN.md before writing components; runs real-browser Lighthouse audits at 100; outputs reusable design systems, not generic AI style.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions UI/UX/design, asks to build or redesign pages or components, work with React, run performance audits, or asks to make a page pretty or match a brand.

say_en.text: Redesign our landing page in Linear's style, DESIGN.md first.
say_en.note: Extracts live styles into DESIGN.md, then rebuilds the UI.

say_en.text: Audit this React app's performance with Lighthouse, fix to 100.
say_en.note: Builds production first; median of multiple runs.

say_en.text: Build a component kit with buttons and forms; add hover and click motion.
say_en.note: Uses the beui.dev catalog for the motion pattern.
